items.mechanism: Do not compute critic parameter gradients during actor optimization; preserve dQ/da.
items.adaptation: Detached functional parameter views inside existing FSDP forwards; no dynamic requires_grad changes. Critic observation encoders avoid graphs that are immediately discarded.
items.checks: Real FSDP Q output and action-gradient comparison; critic gradients absent; full SAC state and RNG comparison.
items.reason: Real FSDP Q/action gradients matched, but the subsequent target-Q parameter allowlist lost q_head. No valid speed measurement. Original Q implementation restored.

items.mechanism: Validate already CPU-resident U weights before transfer, avoiding CUDA-to-Python boolean waits.
items.adaptation: Identical finite/positive/shape/no-grad checks; validation flag is local to a single update and is never replay data.
items.checks: Reject NaN, infinity, zero, negative, wrong shape and gradient-bearing weights; verify same training outputs and replay order.
items.reason: No stable additional improvement over the faster repeated baseline; retained previous accepted production configuration.

items.mechanism: Tune per-process CPU thread count and locality to avoid thread overhead and remote-socket traffic.
items.adaptation: Test two/four Torch threads and CPU affinity matching GPU NUMA topology; no host-global affinity or exclusive CPU reservation.
items.checks: Both forward/reverse timing repeats; same random/replay state; same-layout physical replay and fixed-noise action/U parity for environment worker.
items.reason: No stable additional improvement over the faster repeated baseline; retained previous accepted production configuration.

items.mechanism: Copy only requested CPU joint states and expand an exact MetaControl once per control call.
items.adaptation: Opt-in process-local adapter; source SHA256 guard; GPU state getter and subclasses retain original behavior.
items.checks: Identical requested/effective layout IDs, replayed actions, reward/done signals, states and fixed-noise model actions/U.
items.reason: Same-layout Dojo baseline repetition itself exceeded the fixed action threshold; candidate equivalence and speed benefit remain unproven. All new native switches disabled.

items.mechanism: Temporarily remove real-time rate limiting while rendering at the same manual timestep.
items.adaptation: Only eligible if rate limiter is enabled and manual mode is active; assert unchanged render dt and physics step index; preserve current-frame fences and rendering count.
items.checks: Same-layout replay, model action/U parity and both timing repeats; rejected on guard failure.
items.reason: Same-layout Dojo baseline repetition itself exceeded the fixed action threshold; candidate equivalence and speed benefit remain unproven. All new native switches disabled.

items.mechanism: Compare four physics worker threads with the current default.
items.adaptation: Per-launch Kit argument, persistent settings disabled, read back effective setting; no timestep/solver changes.
items.checks: Strict state, action, U and terminal comparisons; reject physical trajectory drift even if faster.
items.reason: Same-layout Dojo baseline repetition itself exceeded the fixed action threshold; candidate equivalence and speed benefit remain unproven. All new native switches disabled.

items.mechanism: Disable a still-active UI viewport during headless execution.
items.adaptation: Only eligible when an active viewport exists and updates are enabled; sensor cameras remain enabled.
items.checks: Actual camera images, fixed-noise action/U comparison, physical state and terminal parity.
items.reason: Readback showed viewport updates already disabled; no redundant speed claim.

scope: These are source-backed candidates, not promised gains. Adopt only measured candidates passing the same-state tests; keep the previous accepted acceleration configuration otherwise.

harness_references.purpose: Clear in-process compiler specialization caches between benchmark variants, outside timed updates. Five warmups compile the new variant. Formal training does not call reset per update.
